datasets.title: Somalia - Tropical Cyclones hitting Somali Districts for the period(1984-2020)
datasets.description: Tropical cyclones hitting Somalia Districts for the period between 1984 to 2020. This layer indicates the frequency of cyclone occurence within specific regions. The cyclones recorded include: 1984 Tropical Cyclone 1A 1984 Tropical Cyclone 4B 1992 Tropical Cyclone 12A 1994 Tropical Cyclone 05A 1997 Tropical Cyclone 03A 2004 Tropical Cyclone Agni 2010 Tropical Cyclone Bandu 2012 Tropical Cyclone Murjan 2013 Tropical Cyclone 3A 2015 Tropical Cyclone Chapala 2015 Tropical Cyclone Megh 2018 Tropical Cyclone Sagar 2019 Tropical Cyclone Pawan 2020 Tropical Cyclone Gati. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/icpac-geonode-tropical-cyclones-hitting-somali-districts-for-the-period-1984-2020]

contact_point.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

creator.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

lineage.description: Historical tropical cyclone events affecting Somalia from 1984-2020 were compiled by ICPAC and spatially attributed to administrative districts (admin2 level). The dataset records individual cyclone occurrences with dates and aggregates frequency counts per district, providing an empirical hazard inventory without physical intensity measurements or probabilistic modeling.

sources.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
sources.description: Historical tropical cyclone track and occurrence data for Somalia compiled from meteorological records spanning 1984-2020, providing empirical frequency counts per administrative district
